decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 1749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-20.273 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-20.206 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-01-DR-A-20.206 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-R-DR-A-20.208 Rev P02 received: 13/08/2018.
Design and Access Statement Rev 1 dated April 2018, 1749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-10.204 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-01-DR-A-10.205 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-R-DR-A-10.206 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-10.262 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-10.272 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-02-DR-A-20.207 Rev P02, 1749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-20.263 Rev P01, 1749-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-20.254 Rev P02 received: 14/08/2018.
Transport Statement dated: 22 April 2016, and Location Plan 02 Rev P0 received: 04/10/2018.
Transport Technical Note ref: JNY8791-05c Dated 5 October 2018 received: 05/10/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The extension hereby approved shall only be used for B1, B2 and B8 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) and for no other purpose or use without further permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before the extension hereby permitted is first occupied, full details of the proposed cycle parking spaces, in a convenient, covered and secure location with stands that are not vertical or semi-vertical in nature shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities as approved shall then be provided at the site at all times.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the occupation of the development, details of the location of the proposed electric vehicle charging points/bays and the disabled parking bay shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. At least two of the electric vehicle parking bays shall provide electric vehicle charging points capable of an output of at least 7.2kW and a further bay shall be provided with a passive provision. The electric vehicle charging points/bays shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.
description: Erection of a third storey to Units 5 and 6, including over the front and rear recessed areas of the building, and associated landscaping and external works
